subject: removeShapes() not working with numeric layerIDs

messages.author: 24cfda2d37014879
messages.subject: removeShapes() not working with numeric layerIDs
parts:
Hi there,


I have a strange problem, basically I'm trying to show/hide polygons based on a checkbox in a shiny app, and if I assign numeric layerIDs to my polygons then they show up no problem on my leaflet map when the relevant checkbox is ticked BUT the removeShape() function doesn’t work when checkbox is unticked. However if I assign string layerIDs then the shapes look very strange (instead of how the polygon should look I get one line and one box somewhere), but the removeShape() function DOES work, removing shapes when the check box is unticked.

 

Does anyone have any idea what is going on and how I could avoid this happening?


This is what my code looks like:

 

#other code here for reading in shape files (foo_p5, foo_p6, foo_p7, foo_p8, bar_p5, bar_p6, bar_p7, bar_p8) and for creating leaflet map called “leaflet”)

 

options <- c("foo", "bar")

 

observe({

  proxy <- leafletProxy("leaflet")

  cols <- c( 'Black', 'Blue')

 for (i in 1:length(options)) {

    if (options[i] %in% input$checkGroup) {

      for (j in 5:8) {

        idString <- paste0(as.character(i), as.character(j))

        idString <- as.numeric(idString)              #WHEN THIS IS ON, LAYERS MAP NORMALLY (but remove shapes doesn’t work, when it’s off, layers look strange)

        proxy %>% addPolygons(layerId = idString, data=eval(as.symbol(paste0(options[i], "_p",j))), weight = 2, color= cols[i], fill = FALSE, group = paste0("Period ", j))

        }

    }

 }

 

})

 

observe ({

  proxy <- leafletProxy("leaflet")

 

  for (i in 1:length(options)) {

   

    if (!(options[i] %in% input$checkGroup)) {

      

      for (j in 5:8) {

        idString <- paste0(as.character(i), as.character(j))

        idString <- as.numeric(idString) #WHEN THIS IS ON, REMOVESHAPE() DOESN’T WORK (but layers map normally, when it’s off then removeshapes work but layers look strange)

        proxy %>% removeShape(idString)

      }

    }

  }

 

})


Any help would be much appreciated!


Best regards,
Reka
